title: Green Hills Guest Cottage
description:
Apartment is in Historic home in the heart of luxurious Green Hills. The apartment/home faces Woodmont Park and is less than 2 miles from fantastic retail shopping and restaurants, & the celebrated BLUEBIRD CAFE.

Guest access
Apartment's front door access is next to your parking space.  From back door access, you have a back deck and picnic table available to you for use.

Other things to note
Apartment has two cable TVs with streaming services available.

We have raised our kids in this historic stone home in a beautiful area of Nashville.  We now have space to share and enjoy offering it to those folks who want to spend time in Nashville, Music City USA.

We are music lovers and enjoy living in a city where world class music of all types is played.

We've lived in Nashville for over 30 years and plan to be here for the rest of our years.
